ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Modification Of Scheduled Tasks
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects when an attacker tries to modify an already existing scheduled tasks to run from a suspicious location
Attackers can create a simple looking task in order to avoid detection on creation as it's often the most focused on
Instead they modify the task after creation to include their malicious payload

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/Change\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/TN\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WINDOWS\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%ProgramData\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%appdata\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%comspec\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%localappdata\\%.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd\\\.exe\\ \\/r\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*certutil.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bitsadmin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bash\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*bash\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*scrcons.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wmic\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wmic\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*forfiles.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*scriptrunner.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hh\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*hh\\ .*")))
